cards.title: Loss of human connection biggest threat to kids, not AI
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that screens aren't the main danger to children's wellbeing—lack of genuine human connection is. The solution lies in spending more time talking openly with kids rather than limiting technology.

cards.title: Making Halloween magical for your kids this year
cards.body: A parent ditches cynicism to embrace Halloween celebrations as a moment of connection with their children. From ancient traditions like Samhain to modern pumpkin carving, autumn festivities create family magic.

cards.title: Why children say annoying 'na-na' taunt and how to handle it
cards.body: Readers explore why the classic childhood put-down 'Na-na, na-na-na!' is universally irritating to adults. Understanding this universal juvenile behavior helps parents respond with patience.

cards.title: Toxic relatives: where to draw the line for your kids
cards.body: Parents face difficult decisions about limiting children's contact with dysfunctional family members. Key questions help determine healthy boundaries while protecting kids from toxic influences.

cards.title: Whose dream is it? Why we pursue music lessons for kids
cards.body: Behind children's music lessons lies a complex mix of parental regret, desire for social status, and pursuit of an 'ideal self.' Understanding these motivations helps parents make authentic choices for their kids.

cards.title: ADHD has three sometimes clashing definitions
cards.body: ADHD can be viewed through clinical, biological, and social lenses, each offering different perspectives on the condition. Parents benefit from understanding these frameworks when supporting their children.

cards.title: Schools must recognize antisemitism as distinct harm, review says
cards.body: A government review recommends 27 changes to protect students from antisemitism in schools. Recognizing antisemitism as a specific form of harm requires targeted school policies and training.
